title: Jonah and the Border
author: Kestrel Ashgrove
blurb: Kestrel Sterling, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
